output.reason: The release note only says "misc package revision fixes" [ev-8df417ebdd76]. The linked PR calls itself "a bunch of commits" of small improvements and describes only one of them: package revisions are now all reconciled whenever the lock changes. Before this, an active revision that was missing from the lock was never reconciled again, and the author thinks a revision blocked on a dependency could never become healthy [ev-90a79e006866][ev-b942784a0f06]. The other commits are not described, and the changed-files list [ev-6d0b719232c5] shows code paths but no behaviour. The consequence is the author's guess ("I think"), and nothing says which environments are exposed. What's missing is a per-commit description of each fix, or a decision to split the bundle and assert only the lock-reconcile change.
